title: Job detail replays the 28 MB ingest journal twice and hits the BFF 2 s limit

fix.schedule_store_stat_key_guard: JsonlIngestScheduleStore._reload_if_changed_unlocked checks (st_ino, st_size, st_mtime_ns) of ingest_schedule.jsonl against self._read_key (updated at the end of _reload_unlocked and _reload_if_changed_unlocked) across all read-only paths: get_run, get_job, list_runs, list_runs_page, get_receipt, list_receipts, read_freshness_snapshot, get_watermark, list_frontier, and get_frontier.
fix.cross_process_and_inode_safety: Any append by another store instance/process increases st_size and updates st_mtime_ns; replacing the journal file changes st_ino. Both invalidate self._read_key and trigger an immediate replay on the very next read.
fix.job_detail_single_replay_bound: JsonlIngestScheduleStore.get_job(ingest_run_id) reads (run, receipt) under one exclusive_file_lock critical section after a single _reload_if_changed_unlocked() check, and GET /api/source-ingest/jobs/{ingest_run_id} delegates to runtime.store.get_job(ingest_run_id), guaranteeing at most one journal replay per request even when the journal changed and zero replays when unchanged.
fix.write_and_recovery_paths_preserved: All write paths (upsert_run, update_watermark, upsert_receipt, enqueue_frontier, claim_due_frontier, claim_frontier, complete_frontier, replay_frontier, fail_frontier, recover_stale_running) continue calling _reload_unlocked(recover_incomplete=False) before appending, and reload() continues calling _reload_unlocked(recover_incomplete=True) to terminalize incomplete receipts.

measurements_28mb_journal.fixture: 12,100 real IngestRun (5 lifecycle events each) + 12,100 IngestReceipt records in ingest_schedule.jsonl (real line shapes via _seed_hosted_scale_journal)

acceptance_map.5_28mb_journal_before_and_after_measurem: Recorded in measurements_28mb_journal above; also covered by test_bounded_jobs_listing_at_hosted_scale_stays_small_and_fast
acceptance_map.6_no_existing_test_weakened_or_deleted: No existing test was weakened, deleted, or had any assertion changed; 4 new tests were added to services/source_ingestion/test_service.py.
